summary: Explain the bounded extension and the user problem it solves.

evidence.sourceGrammar: Describe declarative syntax, validation, repair and discovery evidence.
evidence.executionCapabilities: Prove the package-owned bounded behavior and capability disposition.
evidence.confinement: Prove canonical source-root confinement and alias or race handling.
evidence.offlineBehavior: Prove compilation and file URL reading require no network access.
evidence.deterministicSerialization: Provide repeated artifact hashes and the supported environment.
evidence.cspAndRuntime: Prove CSP compatibility and bounded package-owned runtime behavior.
evidence.accessibility: Provide semantic, keyboard, touch and assistive technology evidence.
evidence.byteAndPerformanceBudgets: Report measured artifact, runtime, build-time and memory consequences.
evidence.packageDependenciesAndLicenses: List package, transitive dependency and license consequences.
evidence.compatibility: Define source, API, CLI and artifact compatibility plus migration behavior.
